title: AYE FAATEHE KARBOBALA
body:
Aye wursa daare Ambia
Aye Maaliko mulke Khuda
Aye Shaafaye Raoze Jaza
Mamnoon hai Kaaba Tera
Jannat Teri Kausar Tera
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Shaan hai Quraan ki
Tu jaan hai Imaan ki
Tune Khuda ke Deen par
Qurbaan apni jaan ki
Mamnoo'n hai yezdaa'n tera
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ne sahe kitne sitam
Beto'n ka GhamBhai ka Gham
Takra ke Tujh se thak gaye
Zulm o Sitam Ranj o Alam
HamTeri himmat ke fida
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Masjidein ye Aastaa'n
Teri balandi ke nashaa'n
Duniya me baaqi reh gayi
Akbar ke sadqe me Azaa'n
Kaaba bana Raoza Tera
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Laazim hai ye MaatamTera
Waj'he baqa hai GhamTera
Zinda isi Maatam se hai
Deen e Nabi Deen e Khuda
Ye Gham hai Zehra ki Dua
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Tharra rahe the Ambia
Tu ne jo haatho'n par liya
Khaibar ke dar se bhi giraa'n
Laasha jawan farzand ka
Girya kuna the Murtaza
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Arz o Sama'n me goonjti
Awaaz e Halmin hai abhi
Aajaaye Nusrat ko Teri
Hur ki tarah gar ho koyi
Ab bhi hai Dar Tera Khula
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai wo Tera Bawafa
Wo Naa'ebe Shere Khuda
Saahil pa qabza kar ke bhi
Teri qasam pyaasa raha
Darya tadap kar reh gaya
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Maatam hai ye Abbas ka
Pyaaso'n ki anmit pyaas ka
Ahle haram ki bekasi
Aur dard ke ehsaas ka
Qurbaa'n huwi jis par wafa
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaasa Ali Asghar Tera
Wo phool sa sookha gala
Jis ko sawaal e Aab par
Teer e Sitam maara gaya
Tune ye Gham bhi seh liya
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo rege garme Karbala
Daste sitam teghe jafa
Kis zulm se kaata gaya
Maula Tera pyaasa gala
Sar Tera naize par chadha
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Qatl ka Tere sama'n
Maqtal me Zehra ki fugha'n
Is zulm par Roti zamee'n
Aansu bahaata aasmaa'n
Zainab ki wo Aaho Buka
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Kunba nahi'n hai ghar nahi'n
Jalti huwi tapti zamee'n
Dil me Ghamo ranjo alam
Aur Shukre Khaaliq me jabee'n
Sajde me hain Zainul Aba
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekas aseero'n ka safar
Naizo'n pa mazloomo'n ke sar
Shehzaadion ke sar khule
Mehwe tamasha Ahle sharr
Woh taaziaane aur jafa
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahle sitam sab thak gaye
Ashkon pa kab pehre lage
Har daur me ye GhamTera
Ahle wafa karte rahe
MaatamTera kab ruk saka
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh tere naazo'n ki Pali
Beti Teri pyaasirahi
Sehkar harek zulm 0 sitam
Zindaa'n me aakhir Margayi
Beta tera qaidi bana
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis dil me Tera Ghamnahi'n
Kis ghar me ye Maatamnahi'n
Aaqa Tere Gham ki qasam
Ye Ghamnahi'n to Hamnahi'n
Hai zindagi Teri Aza
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemaar ka zakhmi badan
Dulhan ke baazu me rasan
Kulsoom o Zainab be rida
Aur Tera Laasha be kafan
Mehshar na kyun barpa huwa
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Maida'n se Zainab ke Pisar
Aaye lahu me doob kar
Khaime me Laashe hain rakhe
Sajde me hai Zainab ka Sar
Haira'n khade hain Ambia
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Armaan Maadar ke mite
Paamaal Qasim hogaye
Naoshah ka Laasha tha ye
Tukde Dil e Shabbar ke the
Kya haal Kubra ka hua
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Armaa'n hai ye Dilgeer ka
Shabbir ki Hamsheer ka
Jaweed ye jeena bhi hai
Sadqa Gham e Shabbir ka
Dete raho bas ye Sada
<<MINI>>
Aye Faatehe Karbobala
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
